info.title: API.SH: Hugging Face
info.description: The Hugging Face API from API.SH: public Hugging Face data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Curated collections on the Hub: slug, link, title, description, owner, upvotes, last update, gating, and each item (type, id, position, note, likes, downloads). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/huggingface-collections

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: Only collections of this user or organization.

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: Collections containing an item, e.g. `models/meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` (comma-separated for several).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One dataset: the search fields plus all-time downloads, card metadata (task categories, sizes, licenses, source datasets, configs), citation, description (start of the card), files and storage used. With `include=splits`: `structure`, the dataset's configs with their splits, row counts, column counts, sizes and column features (types and class names).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/huggingface-dataset

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The dataset id (owner/name) or its huggingface.co link.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `splits`: also return `structure` (configs, splits, row counts, sizes and column features).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Models on the Hugging Face Hub matching a search and any Hub filter: id, link, author, likes, trending score, downloads in the last month, task (pipeline tag), library, inference status, licenses, languages, base models, training datasets, arXiv ids, tags, gated flag and dates. Filter by parameter count with `min_params`/`max_params`. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/huggingface-models

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words in the model id, e.g. `llama`, `whisper`.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Only models of this user or organization, e.g. `meta-llama`.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Pipeline tag, e.g. `text-generation`, `text-to-image`, `automatic-speech-recognition`, `feature-extraction`. Also accepted as `pipeline_tag`.

parameters.name: dataset
parameters.description: Trained on this dataset id, e.g. `HuggingFaceFW/fineweb`.

parameters.name: base_model
parameters.description: Derived from this model id (fine-tunes, quantizations, adapters).

parameters.name: min_params
parameters.description: Only models with at least this many parameters, e.g. `1B`, `500M`, `7.5B`.

parameters.name: max_params
parameters.description: Only models with at most this many parameters, e.g. `3B`, `70B`.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Any other Hub tags, comma-separated, e.g. `gguf,conversational`.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Only models served by this inference provider, e.g. `together`, `groq`.

parameters.name: gated
parameters.description: `true` or `false`: only gated or only open models.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
